goal: Show academic preparation, program fit, and realistic career direction.

structure.instruction: State your academic interest and the exact program you want to study.
Summarize relevant education, performance, projects, and skills.
Show relevant experience that supports the program.
Explain modules, specialization, or academic strengths.
Mention faculty, facilities, structure, or academic resources.
Describe short-term and long-term goals after completion.

banned_phrases: I have always wanted to study in Malaysia since childhood
I will do anything to get admitted
this is my way to stay in Malaysia
the visa is my main concern
preferred_language: My background in X has prepared me for...
This program aligns with my interest in...
The curriculum offers the specialization I need in...
I intend to develop expertise in...
After completing this program, I plan to...
quality_checklist: The program and university are named clearly
The document matches the offer letter and supporting files
